## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals confirmed by broad sector strength (Utilities XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%)) alongside conflicted risk indicators: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) — risk/cycle readings flat overall.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear a touch higher: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising; credit stable: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) → near-neutral HYG/LQD. Sector breadth tilt toward defensives/energy (XLU, XLE, XLP) is the primary support for equities.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing. TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ↑ rising (bonds rally), UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) showing mixed dollar pressure.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive/commodity leadership: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ↑ rising, while Tech is weak — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) ↓ falling. Style: Defensive/commodity strength over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) while Japan/EU/EM showing pockets of strength — EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%). China lagging: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%) ↓ falling.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Muted. IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) ↓ falling and ETHA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -36.15%) show weakness, while ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) signals limited, uneven risk-on flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/energy up: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising. Gold RECOVERY (GLD 1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) shows safe-haven buying alongside large silver bounce SLV RECOVERY (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy clear strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising, while nat gas is weak — UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) ↓ falling.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%)) and long-duration bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%)) both positive across frames. Minor divergence: several CORRECTION readings (XLI CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +7.92%), IJR CORRECTION (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +2.08%)) imply short-term rotation/pullbacks.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive/commodity exposures and select fixed income: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%), LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%); reduce exposure to tech beta: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) and speculative crypto ETFs like IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%), XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLRE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.32%). BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%), IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%), URA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -12.09%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (watch for de-risk if rises above) — VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising; HYG/LQD parity ~0.80 (credit health) — HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%), LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%); XLK break point vs XLE at a 2.0 ratio to signal growth vs commodity pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive.  
Utilities/energy/real estate showing relative strength (XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%), XLRE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.32%)).  
Key risk: tech weakness and weak China (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%)) with minor short-term divergences to monitor (multiple CORRECTION signals).
